letter.title: The key is under the blue pot
letter.text:
You won't remember me. I farmed beside your grandmother Ilse.
The river went east after the flood, and most folk went too.
Her fields are dust now, but the soil remembers. So do I.
One more farmer, and the Wend might not be forgotten.
The key is under the blue pot.

farmGreen.note: The farm looks greener this morning.

spring.name: Old Spring
spring.sign: The Old Spring. Choked with stones.

work.text: You lever stones off the spring's mouth. Water glints under them.
The last big stone rolls clear. The pool fills, slowly.
Rosa hands you Ilse's spade. One cut, and the water follows it.

opening.note: Water in the old creek bed this morning!
lines: Ilse dug that first channel the spring I was born.
Go on. The farm's been waiting for it.

farm.deltaText: The old creek bed. Best left clear.

wendhead.deltaText: The spring's old bed. Best left clear.
